name: B
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. A high-fidelity flat WEBPAGE DESIGN comp for MamAlina Center, Hebrew RTL strength-training studio and separate breathing clinic in Kfar Szold. Show the whole first viewport and two distinct sections below at 1440px wide, approximately 1500px tall. No device frame or presentation board. Brand world: crisp white, near black #121416, warm taupe #AF9987 from the attached new logo. Architectural faceted lines from the heart/MA monogram, athletic broadcast-scale heavy modern Hebrew sans typography, cinematic real training photography, clean rectangular controls, no serif display, no pastel cards or glass. The attached logo is authoritative: exactly "MamAlina Center" and its geometric faceted heart. The second image is the actual coach Alina, use her recognizable face, body, pose, and actual setting in photographic regions. Do not invent a different gym, people as clients, statistics, prices, reviews, awards, or dates. This should be exceptionally distinctive professional sports-web art direction. It must be legible as a webpage with real navigation and CTAs, not a poster. Hebrew text flows RTL. CONCEPT B: THE CAMPAIGN. Above-fold topology: white header with small black navigation, correct logo on right, taupe "בואו נדבר" button on left. Giant black Hebrew headline takes up upper third "להתחזק." on right and "בדרך שלכם." on the next line, set with confident tight but legible tracking. A huge angular photographic cut inspired by ONE FACET of the logo crosses behind and through the open left part of this white typographic field, showing the actual athlete strength training in monochrome. Do not put a normal rectangular photograph beside copy; the photographic area has an asymmetric diagonal right edge and reaches the viewport's left edge. Bottom-right part of the first viewport has one compact service explanation and a bold taupe arrow CTA. Barely overlapping the bottom of the campaign field is a black wide horizontal strip with the words "כוח" "דיוק" "נשימה" beautifully separated, no fake stats. Below: open white asymmetric coach section with headline "נעים להכיר, אני אלינה." a natural image, and restrained paragraph group. Third section: a black canvas with two staggered wide landscape service images; "אימוני כוח" has an actual training photo and "נשימה וריברסינג" has a sparse abstract geometric composition made only of the logo's fine faceted lines. The two service text links are clear. This direction must feel like an athletic campaign designed by an exceptional editorial studio, big type and geometric identity working as ONE composition. No tiny corner thumbnails. Core real UI Hebrew; small filler text may be greeked.
